Peter,

My name is Emily, and I'm a ballot chaser for Turning Point PAC in Arizona.

That means every day, I show up, knock on doors, have conversations with potential voters, and chase down ballots before Election Day.

I need to tell you what I'm seeing out here, because I don't think most people understand how close this really is.

body:
A Bush-Quayle state chair and a former Democratic councilwoman agree on this race.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/16bJxynl9T0?e=a7b299e420&c2id=1b040b68f1d062d0c966c24dae99fcb4)
| | | | Peter, On Monday, the Spokesman-Review ran a piece written by a couple of Eastern Washingtonians. I want you to see it. It was written by people who have spent their careers on opposite sides. Rich Kuhling chaired George H.W. Bush and Dan Quayle's 1992 campaign in Washington State, and chaired George Nethercutt's 1994 campaign for this very seat. Candace Mumm managed Democrat Rich Cowan's 2012 campaign for Congress, and served on the Spokane City Council. They don't always agree on policy but they agree on this race. Here's what they wrote: **_"In this tipping-point election, we see the need to disregard party affiliation."_** **_"We look for someone guided by the oath to office rather than fealty to a person, even if it's the president."_** They pointed out that this district has crossed party lines before – for Democrat Tom Foley and for Republican George Nethercutt – and they closed with this: **_"We urge you to do the same and join us in voting to make a change for us at home and for the rest of the country."_** [](https://us.list-manage.com/eDcSgXbhJ62?e=a7b299e420&c2id=1b040b68f1d062d0c966c24dae99fcb4) [**_Rich and Candace told me that since the piece ran, people have been calling them to ask how they can donate. If this op-ed moved you too, will you chip in $10 right now to help us reach every voter who's ready to cross party lines?_**](https://us.list-manage.com/1BwG0grCsjY?e=a7b299e420&c2id=1b040b68f1d062d0c966c24dae99fcb4) | _If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process immediately._

clean_body: We need that same energy for the final days of this election. | Team — Have I ever told you the story behind my nickname? A few years ago, people in Detroit started calling me Big Gretch. I definitely didn’t come up with it myself. And the first time I heard it, I thought it was pretty funny. And, well... it stuck. Over the years, I’ve heard “Big Gretch” shouted at rallies, seen it on homemade signs, and had people stop me on the street to say it. I've loved it ever since. = Because the thing I love most about the nickname is that it came from the people. It wasn’t cooked up in some meeting or something I chose for myself. People just started saying it, having fun with it, and making it their own. And all these years later, that still makes me smile. The truth is, "Big Gretch" has always reminded me that we're in this together. The best things we've built have always started with people deciding to be part of the team. Peter, Everyone’s talking about the battle to control Congress — and for good reason! It’s a huge deal. But not enough people are focused on flipping key state legislative chambers. And those races are critical. The outcomes will directly decide day-to-day issues like education and health care. And they’ll decide strength-of-democracy issues like redistricting and voting rights. That’s where this team comes in. Powered by supporters like you, the NDRC is fighting to flip battleground chambers from red to blue across five states: Arizona, Georgia, New Hampshire, Pennsylvania, Texas, and Wisconsin. In several of those states, we have a path to gain control of both chambers. What's more, we’ve identified 213 Democracy Defenders running in those five states who are committed to upholding fair maps and fighting back against egregious gerrymanders. name: Roy Cooper
subject: What the president and VP said at recent NC rallies
body:
We can’t afford to not fight back this close to Election Day.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1774&source=&t=1&akid=5027%2E124072%2EpVV_I1) | | | |
---
Peter,
Last week, Vice President JD Vance came to Hendersonville to attack me and rally the MAGA base in support of my GOP opponent, Michael Whatley. (He also embarrassed himself by implying “Raleigh-Durham” was our capital city’s name – not the airport where he left Air Force 2.)
The next day, President Trump came for another pro-Whatley rally in Greenville. He told that crowd a lot of lies, too – about me, my record and the grassroots movement we’re building. (He also warned that he’d only approve compensation for veterans exposed to contaminated water at Camp Lejeune if the GOP won the midterms, saying, _“If we don’t win, there’s no money.”_ Disgraceful.)
If that wasn’t enough, Vance was back in North Carolina this afternoon to double down on his attacks – and a Trump-aligned super PAC is now throwing Whatley another million-dollar lifeline in a last-ditch effort to keep this swing seat red. **That’s why it’s so worrying that we’re not on track to reach our $5 million end-of-month goal by the deadline on Saturday night.**
Now, I know you know this, Peter, but in light of the back-to-back rallies and uptick in attack ads _this_ close to Election Day, we have no room for error this time.
If we don’t hit this goal, our get-out-the-vote teams may not have the resources they need to keep working through Election Day. Our ads might not stay on the air statewide. With only six days left to reach NC voters and Senate control on the line, that is not a risk we can afford to take.
**Will you please chip in at this link now to help me fight back and flip this seat – and with it, the Senate – blue? I can’t pull this off without you.
[_https:/ /secure.actblue.com/donate/cooperemail_](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1774&amount=5&t=8&akid=5027%2E124072%2EpVV_I1)**
Thanks for coming through tonight,

Roy Cooper
| |

[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1774&t=2&akid=5027%2E124072%2EpVV_I1)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

### About Chaz Molder

Dear
Peter,
This past week, I had the pleasure of joining guest host Sam Peters on The Wayne Allyn Root show to discuss my campaign for Assembly District 37.

We covered a lot of ground during the interview, including the coming fight over tax increases, the Democrats’ dangerous attacks on our brave men and women in law enforcement and how they’re undermining our public safety, and the importance of rebuilding Nevada’s economy in a way that promotes economic liberty and prosperity.

Above all, we talked about what’s at stake this November — the competing visions between myself and my left-wing opponent, and why winning this race is so important to breaking the Democrats’ stranglehold on our state legislature.

I hope you’ll click below to take a listen ... and as always, I’d love any feedback or comments you’d like to provide!
https://andyfornevada.com/andy-matthews_sam-peters_8-28-20/
***

By the way, I was also honored this week to receive the endorsement of the National Rifle Association. I’ve long been a proud champion of the Second Amendment, and it’s an absolute thrill to have the support of our nation’s preeminent defender of the right to bear arms.

Especially today, with Nevada’s Democrats waging a relentless assault on our Second Amendment rights (for her part, my opponent received an “F” grade from the NRA), it’s more important than ever that we elect those who will unapologetically defend our Constitution. And you can count on me to do exactly that in Carson City.

For Nevada’s future,

Andy

Here are five reasons to vote for Justin Early.
1. **I know what a tight budget feels like.** I grew up in a working-class family and I raised one. I know what it is to be one bad week away from real trouble. That is why affordability comes first: protecting Social Security, protecting American jobs and workers, and fighting for affordable healthcare.
2. **I have served.** After Leander High School I enlisted in the Army. I served as a paratrooper at Fort Bragg and later as a systems administrator at the Defense Intelligence Agency in the Pentagon after 9/11. I will fight for veterans in Congress.
3. **I protect data for a living.** I am a cybersecurity architect. I will put guardrails on AI and make data centers answer to the neighbors who live next to them. Technology without accountability is not progress.
4. **I will defend our democracy.** That means protecting our security, our veterans, our neighbors and a fair immigration system.

A lot of the work that goes into running a campaign happens behind the scenes. It's the clipboards volunteers carry while canvassing, the literature they hand to voters at the door, the signs supporters put in their yards, and the staff making sure every event, phone bank, and canvass runs smoothly.

Team,
In the weeks leading up to Election Day, Trump and right-wing influencers have spent most of their time creating more doubt and distrust about our elections.

Hey folks,
I wanted to reach out and let you know how much this team means to me.
My team noticed you and flagged you as a grassroots supporter who is truly dedicated to doing whatever it takes to flip this seat and take back our Senate Majority. I don't take your support for granted.
Can I remind you of why I got into this race?
As a fifth-generation logger from Allagash, I got my start in politics after a greedy landowner tried to screw me and my fellow loggers out of fair wages.
**I stayed in this fight because if we want to see real change in our system, we need working-class voices in the rooms where decisions are made.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dd3be8b8-3d15-4d0e-b482-357c315dad5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

**[If you believe in fighting for working people and retiring Susan Collins for good, can you chip in a donation right away to help us power our campaign through Election Day?](https://substack.com/redirect/dd3be8b8-3d15-4d0e-b482-357c315dad5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ CHIP IN TO RETIRE SUSAN COLLINS >>](https://substack.com/redirect/dd3be8b8-3d15-4d0e-b482-357c315dad5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Here's the current situation, folks: recent polling shows that Susan Collins and I are practically neck and neck in this race. And political pundits across the country are predicting that this seat will be the difference between a Democratic- or GOP-led Senate Majority.
Susan Collins and her allies may have amassed over $114 million to defeat me, but I have something that they don't: **the power of this grassroots team.**
My team just let me know we need to raise another $132,638 this evening to hit our critical $1,000,000 final end-of-month fundraising goal before the election. If even 3% of folks reading this were able to chip in, we'd make up the difference in no time.
**[I'm incredibly grateful for any support you've shown my campaign so far. But the truth is, with just 6 days to go, I have no choice but to ask, can you dig deep and chip in $10 to help us retire Susan Collins and take back the Senate Majority?](https://substack.com/redirect/dd3be8b8-3d15-4d0e-b482-357c315dad5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Grateful for you always,
Troy

There is no fixing affordability without fixing housing costs. Rent is the biggest bill most families pay, and decades of underbuilding made it worse.

My plan cuts the red tape that makes homes slow and expensive to build. It doubles federal affordable housing production.

It pays for a generational investment in social and affordable housing by reversing big parts of the Trump tax cuts for corporations and the wealthy.

This isn’t a promise from someone who just started working on housing. This has been my passion for over a decade.

In 2012, I upzoned my own supervisor district. In the Senate, I wrote legislation to fast-track affordable housing in cities that fall behind, and allow more homes near transit.

**Billionaires and special interests would prefer Congress didn’t make the kind of progress California has on housing — and they’re doing everything they can to stop me because they know how much I’m capable of.**

[Will you donate $5, $10 or whatever you can afford right now towards our voter outreach efforts so we can reach San Franciscans with my record of results before they vote in this important election?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142408249/656855475/-1968648407?amount=10&refcode=SW_EM_FR_180DO_261028_3_3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDY5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OGE1MjZjMC0zOGQzLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyNGQ0ZGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=urSFJ3rf7iAi5_4fq3086IomYSFXGH4ZUmEMHGrkrQM=)

body:
Peter,
If you’ve been keeping an eye on the fight to retake a Democratic majority in the Senate, you probably already know that competitive seats in states like Maine, Texas, and Alaska are currently in play for Democrats. That is massively exciting news.
But as much as I want Democrats to win those races, we have to be realistic about the math. The fact of the matter is that **Republicans only need to flip Michigan in order to hold onto their majority.**
If they flip this seat in Michigan, our chances at winning the Senate are _toast_.
I don’t say all this to scare you, but I want to be honest about what this means for our race:
* Republicans have made me their #1 target to beat in November, and they are dropping $1 million a day on ads from now until Election Day.

* That means the hundreds of thousands of Michiganders who are currently choosing whether to vote for me, Mike Rogers, or whether to even vote at all are being swamped with attack ads in this final push.

The window to make a difference in the outcome of this race is closing fast, so if you’ve been waiting for the right moment to make your first contribution* to our campaign, _this is it._ **Will you please donate $5 so we can hold onto this must-win Senate seat? The path to a Democratic Senate runs straight through Michigan.**

subject: I couldn’t have imagined this
body:
I never could have imagined that the next Democratic governor of Texas might just be my wife.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Hi Peter, it’s John Donisi, Gina’s husband. I’m going to be honest: I’ve been told to keep this email short, and I’m already ignoring that because I could talk about my wife all day.
Here’s something most people don’t know: The last Democratic Governor of Texas was my boss.
When I was a young staffer, I worked for Governor Ann Richards. Back then, _I never could have imagined that the next Democratic Governor of Texas might just be the woman I get to call my wife_. Some days I still can’t believe she said yes.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20261028_4_john.ZP-PSw&refcode=em20261028-2577&t=1&akid=2577%2E299639%2EsiBy1j)
_Gina and me – way back when!_
Since Gina launched this campaign last October, it’s been a wild ride. The pundits said she had zero statewide name ID and no path. I just smiled, because they’d clearly never met her. I have. **I married her 27 years ago, and I’ve been watching her prove people wrong every day since.**
I’ve watched her fight to keep our son's school from closing. I’ve watched her go to the mat for public education in the Texas House. And over the past year, I’ve had the best seat in the house watching her crisscross this state from sunrise to way past midnight, standing up for every single Texan. I’m usually the guy holding her iced tea. I’ve never been prouder to have a job.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20261028_4_john.ZP-PSw&refcode=em20261028-2577&t=2&akid=2577%2E299639%2EsiBy1j)
_Gina and me getting ready to vote in the primary this March._
**I’m biased, I know. But I mean it from the bottom of my heart: There is no one smarter, kinder, or more relentless than Gina. Texas doesn’t know how lucky it’s about to be when she wins this race.**
A few months ago, the experts had written her off. Today, this race is neck and neck, and she hasn’t given up on Texas for a single second. **Now it comes down to whether we all show up for her in these final, critical days.**
Early voting is in its final stretch, and we need everyone with us right now to support Gina and get our voters to the polls.
**[Will you pitch in $5 or any amount today to help Gina reach her critical $3 million fundraising goal before Saturday’s deadline?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261028_4_john.Wsqlrn&refcode=em20261028-2577&amount=5&t=3&akid=2577%2E299639%2EsiBy1j)**
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261028_4_john.Wsqlrn&amount=5&refcode=em20261028-2577&t=22&akid=2577%2E299639%2EsiBy1j)
Thank you for supporting Gina, Peter. It means more to me than I can say.
— John Donisi, Gina’s husband (and #1 fan)

**LILY TANG WILLIAMS CRUSHES MAGGIE GOODLANDER AT WMUR DEBATE

_Goodlander claims Donald Trump is a bigger threat to America than Communist China; goes on-record supporting higher property taxes for Granite Staters_**

WEARE, NH — Republican congressional nominee Lily Tang Williams declared victory in tonight's WMUR debate, drawing a sharp contrast between her commitment to affordability, accountability, and the American Dream and Congresswoman Maggie Goodlander's record in Washington. A couple highlights of the debate included when Williams challenged Goodlander over her opposition to Question 2, an important measure that would limit property tax increases for Granite Staters, and her assertion that President Donald Trump somehow poses a greater threat to America than Communist China — an authoritarian regime responsible for severe human rights abuses against its own people. Williams also drew a sharp contrast with Goodlander's privileged upbringing, support for other higher tax bills, her work to strip law-abiding New Hampshire citizens of their Second Amendment rights, and her thin record overall in her first term in Congress. “Tonight, voters saw the difference between someone who lived the American Dream and someone who was handed every opportunity by the Washington establishment,” said Williams. “Maggie Goodlander has had her chance in Congress, and Granite Staters are still struggling to afford groceries, housing, and heating bills. She even opposes efforts to rein in property taxes. She offers excuses. I offer results.” “I escaped communism, built a life from nothing, and know what a real threat to freedom looks like,” Williams added. “For Maggie Goodlander to suggest Donald Trump is a greater threat to America than Communist China shows just how out-of-touch Washington has become. On November 3rd, Granite Staters can reject the Washington establishment and elect someone who will actually fight for them.” Lily's General Consultant Michael Biundo added: "We are getting close to Halloween. Unfortunately for Maggie Goodlander, her moderate mask is falling off. What we witnessed tonight, was pure Leftist extremism that Granite Staters will reject next week."

**About Lily Tang Williams**
Born in China just before Mao’s Cultural Revolution to working-class parents, Lily Tang Williams immigrated to the United States with nothing and built a life as an entrepreneur, educator, and community leader in Weare, NH. A living embodiment of the American Dream, she brings a uniquely powerful perspective to the fight for freedom and limited government.

In 2024, Williams won the Republican nomination and captured 47% of the general election vote against current incumbent Maggie Goodlander — coming closer than any Republican has in more than a decade to flipping NH-02. She is back and running stronger than ever in 2026.

name: Chris Pappas
subject: If you’re new here...
body:
I'm not running to make history - I'm running to make a difference for every Granite Stater who feels like their voice isn't being heard by those who represent them.

| |
---|---|---
|
# If you're new here...
### I'm not running to make history - I'm running to make a difference for every Granite Stater who feels like their voice isn't being heard by those who represent them.
| | | [Chris Pappas](https://substack.com/@chrispappasnh)
---
| Oct 28
---
| [](https://substack.com/@chrispappasnh)
---
It's Chris.
If you walk into my family's restaurant in Manchester on any given afternoon, you'll hear the same sounds I've heard my entire life: the clinking of coffee mugs, the hum of blenders, and the rhythm of neighbors talking in a booth. **It 's the sound of New Hampshire -- and the community that shaped me.**
My great-grandfather started his business 109 years ago. He was a Greek immigrant who didn't have much, but he believed that if you worked hard, treated people right, and gave back to your community, this country would give you a fair shot.
Long before I served in Congress, I was in the kitchen at the restaurant making homemade ice cream. In a year we'd churn out more than 35,000 gallons of it!
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/55952f38-e975-4c90-8648-7b51d63f630f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/55952f38-e975-4c90-8648-7b51d63f630f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Helping run my family's small business showed me the power of hard work and serving others.
But unfortunately the opportunity that my ancestors and others sought has never been further away, and Donald Trump and his administration are too busy cutting deals for their billionaire buddies to give a damn.
**I decided to run for Senate to change that.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/55952f38-e975-4c90-8648-7b51d63f630f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[ DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/55952f38-e975-4c90-8648-7b51d63f630f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I've traveled across the Granite State on the campaign trail -- from the Seacoast to the North Country -- and the stories I hear are the same: People are working harder than ever and doing everything right but still seem to be falling behind.
The system isn't working. More often than not, it feels rigged for those at the top -- while the rest of us are just trying to scrape by.
**That 's why I'm running for Senate:** We deserve leaders who fight for all of us, not just the wealthy and well-connected. And it's about time that our economy works for everyone.
_I 'm also running to bring a new voice to the Senate and stand up for all Granite Staters._
Growing up in New Hampshire, I often wondered if there would be a place for me here -- if I'd be able to live openly and authentically in the state I love. I certainly never imagined I could one day be elected to public office as a member of the LGBTQ+ community.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/55952f38-e975-4c90-8648-7b51d63f630f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/55952f38-e975-4c90-8648-7b51d63f630f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
After college I returned home to help run my family's restaurant and decided to run for the state legislature because I wanted to give back to the city and state that had given me so many opportunities.
And somewhat to my surprise, not only did my community accept me, they gave me their trust and sent me to Concord to serve them.
I'll never forget the first speech I made from the State House floor. At the time marriage equality was far from the law of the land, and the legislature was debating a bill that would have prohibited New Hampshire from recognizing same-sex marriages performed in other states.
I told my colleagues that the bill ran counter to the "Live Free or Die" spirit we're so proud of in New Hampshire and that we shouldn't be legislating based on fear or hate or trying to punish people for who they love.
Unfortunately the bill passed, and we lost that fight. _But we didn 't give up._
We persevered, and not long after the legislature passed a new bill recognizing civil unions between same-sex partners. And a few years after that, New Hampshire became the first state in the nation to legalize marriage equality through legislative action.
It was a remarkable turnaround that showed real progress is possible, and that's made an immeasurable difference in the lives of so many who call New Hampshire home -- including my husband and me.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/55952f38-e975-4c90-8648-7b51d63f630f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/55952f38-e975-4c90-8648-7b51d63f630f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**I 'm not running to make history -- I'm running to make a difference for every Granite Stater who feels like their voice isn't being heard by those who represent them.**
During this campaign the contrast between me and my opponent, John Sununu, has only grown stronger.
I've spent my time in Congress taking on tough fights. I'm ranked one of the most bipartisan members of the House because I'll always look for a chance to deliver results. But I'll also take on anyone to do what's best for New Hampshire -- regardless of political party.
_We 're seeing a different approach from Sununu and the Republican side._
The GOP sows extreme rhetoric and threatens our fundamental freedoms -- from attacks on reproductive rights to a Trump Administration that's more focused on helping billionaire insiders than lowering costs for families here in New Hampshire.
**We can 't go backward.**
I've beaten their dangerous agenda before. When I first ran for Congress in 2018, people said a Democrat couldn't hold a district like ours for more than a single term. We proved them wrong by staying grounded in our values.
Every day on the campaign trail, I feel that same momentum.
I see it in the seniors who pull me aside to talk about prescription drug costs, and I see it in the young people showing up to No Kings Rallies and getting involved in politics for the first time.
This fight will only get tougher as the national Republicans pour money into the state to try to eclipse our progress. But if there's one thing churning out all that ice cream at my family's restaurant taught me, it's that you show up and work hard every single day.
**We 're just getting started. I'm ready for the work ahead. I'm ready for the big fights. And I'm ready to be a Senator who always has your back.**
Thank you for reading,
Chris
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/55952f38-e975-4c90-8648-7b51d63f630f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

And the only reason that is the case is because tens of thousands of supporters like you have chipped in a little bit here and there over the last 18 months to help us build a movement to flip the most competitive House district in the country. It’s something I’m really proud of. But we aren’t done yet. In 2024, Elon Musk spent more in NY-17 than any other congressional district to help elect Lawler—and a huge chunk of that money came in during the final few days. The unfortunate reality that this type of money could still stop us if we stall out now. NY-17 is one of just three districts that split their ticket in 2024. Derek, it’s Chris.
I just walked offstage from our final Senate debate in New Hampshire. I’m proud of the case we made tonight, and I’m ready to finish what we started eighteen months ago.
Now we have just six days to beat John Sununu and help Democrats take back the Senate. But I’ll be direct with you: We set out to raise $100,000 by the time the debate ended, and we’re falling short. That’s why I’m reaching out right now. This team has stepped up time and time again. [**If you can, pitch in $20 or whatever you can split between our campaign and the DNC to help us reach our goal before midnight tonight and take back the Senate.**](https://ak.democrats.org/go/2234?c0=em-dnc-pappas-split.1iR0xc&amount=20&refcode=em_20261028_10118_fr&t=7&akid=10118%2E22930333%2EhNFy9t)

Tonight Granite Staters saw a clear choice.
I’m fighting to protect Social Security. People spend their working lives paying into it, and they deserve to know those benefits will be there when they retire. I’ll always oppose cuts. John Sununu still refuses to tell voters where he stands, and his last plan was to privatize it.
That difference matters. **And with Election Day just six days away, we need to make sure voters hear it.**
John Sununu has Donald Trump’s endorsement and tens of millions of dollars in outside Republican spending behind him. They’re counting on their dark money to drown out our message in these final days.
_We can’t let that happen._
We need to keep our ads on the air, our organizers in the field, and our campaign reaching voters through next Tuesday. This race could help decide who controls the Senate, and every day between now and Election Day matters.
We don’t take corporate PAC money. This campaign is powered by people like you, and we’re counting on this grassroots team to help us finish strong.
[**Will you chip in $20 tonight to my campaign and the DNC to help us hit our goal before midnight tonight? Every dollar we raise helps us reach more voters, beat John Sununu, and flip the Senate blue.**](https://ak.democrats.org/go/2234?c0=em-dnc-pappas-split.1iR0xc&amount=20&refcode=em_20261028_10118_fr&t=9&akid=10118%2E22930333%2EhNFy9t)

I want to take a moment to remind you of my journey to the U.S. Senate, the important lessons I have learned along the way, and why I continue to believe wholeheartedly in our beloved state.
My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty.
From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming.
Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. Just as in surgery, effective leadership requires a clear vision and a strategic approach to problem-solving.
As you may know, I am sometimes referred to as _"Wyoming's doctor,"_ but to be honest, that is what I have always strived to be as your senator. I have wholeheartedly dedicated myself to serving the state, addressing its challenges, and making it the best it can be.
**_Whether it's advocating for our veterans, championing American energy security, or safeguarding our borders, I've always strived to be a voice for all Wyoming people. Your concerns are my concerns, and your aspirations are my aspirations._**

body:
$1. That’s all we’re asking for today.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
Greg Abbott relies on a handful of mega-donors writing half-a-million-dollar checks just to keep him in power.
But not us. **Our campaign relies on hardworking people who’ve supported this campaign from the start and believe in Gina’s vision for a better Texas.**
Since Gina launched her campaign, we’ve built our movement across Texas — from the Panhandle down to the Rio Grande Valley, and all the small towns and big cities in between.
Normally, when we reach out, we ask for $2.54 — a single penny for every county in Texas that Greg Abbott has ignored.
**But today we have a different request — we’re asking 254 people from 18326 to chip in $1 today, so we can keep our organizers on the ground across the state.**
**[If you’re ready to help us reach Texans across this huge state, will you be one of the 254 people from 18326 who pitch in just $1 right now?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1992?c0=em_ms_gh_20261028_5_dollar.eIS6AT&refcode=em20261028-2574&t=1&akid=2574%2E299639%2ESzXIlN)**
When Gina travels across Texas, she doesn't just stop in major cities. She sits down with small business owners fighting to keep their doors open, public school teachers buying their own classroom supplies, and families dealing with skyrocketing costs.
Everywhere we go, we hear the same thing — they’re tired of Greg Abbott selling them out to the person with the deepest pocket.
**Chipping in $1 today sends a direct message that people in 18326 are ready for a governor who’ll work for them.**
It also helps us have the resources for organizers on the ground, keeps our message on the airwaves, and ensures no community in Texas is left behind.
**[So Peter, will you be one of the 254 people from 18326 to donate just $1 today to support Gina’s campaign?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1992?c0=em_ms_gh_20261028_5_dollar.eIS6AT&refcode=em20261028-2574&t=2&akid=2574%2E299639%2ESzXIlN)**

Thank you,
Team Gina

body:
I’m not reaching out to everyone today – just a select few, including you.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1784&source=&t=1&akid=5037%2E124072%2EI5DJxX) | | | |
---
Peter, I’m not reaching out to everyone today – just a select few, including you.
My team was going through our supporter records, and we noticed how yours stood out from the crowd. You’re one of my most attentive grassroots supporters. You’ve been getting these emails for a while now, and we see you're keeping up with the latest on this election. I want you to know that _I know_ how engaged you’ve been with our campaign and how much I appreciate it.
**Today, I’m asking you to take the next step. Here's why:**
Grassroots fundraising has slowed down recently, and it couldn’t come at a worse time. Republican super PACs have poured tens of millions into North Carolina to defeat me, and JD Vance was just in North Carolina yesterday for yet _another_ MAGA rally with my opponent.
We need to turn this around fast – and the first step is getting back on track to hit our $5 million end-of-month goal. [**_Will you chip in $5 right now to help us reach this critical goal before our last end-of-month deadline of the campaign? The stakes could not be higher._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1784&amount=5&t=8&akid=5037%2E124072%2EI5DJxX)
North Carolina is the best chance Democrats have to flip one of the four seats we need to take back the Senate, so if we lose here, we lose our shot at flipping the majority. The only way we’ll avoid that is by building the resources to compete with the massive amounts of GOP spending.
**Unlike my MAGA opponent Michael Whatley, I’m not a Washington DC insider who can rely on his billionaire connections to buy this Senate seat. I’m depending on people like you, giving what you can, when you can, at crucial moments like this.**
_With five days to go until Election Day, Peter, I need you._
[**_Time’s running out, so I’m personally asking: Will you please chip in your first $5 donation to my campaign today so we can hit our $5 million goal, flip North Carolina’s critical seat and help Democrats secure the Senate majority?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1784&amount=5&t=9&akid=5037%2E124072%2EI5DJxX)

Roy

name: Chris Deluzio
subject: If we win…
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Deluzio for Congress
body:
Not complicated. Not radical.
# [](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/46?t=1&akid=162%2E42639%2ExkMlk6)
As the last Democrat holding a battleground House seat in Pennsylvania, I am working hard to ensure I'm still part of Congress after this election.
And one of the most important questions I get on the trail is what happens if Democrats take back the House.
Good question.
And it doesn't need to be complicated.
Our promise to voters should be simple: You work hard, you bust your butt, you play by the rules and you get to live a good and decent life.
That's what it should be all about. Our North Star.
Ok... but what does that mean practically?
It means if you do those things you have a roof over your head, living where you want to and being able to do it with one job. Not two jobs, not three jobs ... one job.
It means you get to start a family when you want and be able to spend time with your newborn child after they are born. And by the way, no politician is going to tell a woman in a doctor's office what to do with her pregnancy.
It means being able to go to the doctor when you need to and being able to get the medicine you need to live a healthy life without going bankrupt.
It means being able to take your family to a ballgame, or a movie, going on a vacation every now and again and eventually retire with some dignity.
Not complicated and not radical.
And if Democrats take back the House (and Senate) it also means there will be some oversight and accountability for the war with Iran and the rampant corruption of this administration.
That is what I am campaigning on, and that is what I will fight for if Democrats take back the House.
If that sounds good to you, and if you are inclined to make a last-minute contribution to help me hold this seat, it'd mean a lot.

→ a Governor who will wipe out all Democratic power when the far-right
holds every state-level office in Pennsylvania — with nobody left to

# **OPERATION RED OCTOBER: Trick or Knock. Every Door Counts.**
Election Day is just around the corner, and **Tusk Force is gearing up for one final statewide push!** On **Saturday, October 31** , Republicans across Indiana will hit the streets for [**Operation Red October**](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fhiykhl-hhlljjcji-r/) , a Halloween door-knocking blitz to connect with voters, build momentum, and help deliver Republican victories up and down the ballot on November 3. [](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fhiykhl-hhlljjcji-y/) With just days until Election Day, every door knocked and every conversation had makes a difference. **We're calling on Republicans across the state to step up, get involved, and help get our candidates across the finish line.**
### **THE MISSION: GET OUT THE VOTE!**
Tusk Force volunteers will be knocking doors in communities across Indiana, encouraging Hoosiers to cast their ballots and make their voices heard.**Here's how you can help:**
* **Knock doors:** Join your local Tusk Force team and help reach voters.
* **Bring a friend:** Recruit family, friends, and fellow Republicans to volunteer.
* **Spread the word:** Share your county's event flyer and encourage others to participate.
* **Get out the vote:** Remind friends and neighbors to vote before polls close on November 3.

### **FIND AN EVENT NEAR YOU!**
Operation Red October events are taking place in counties across Indiana. Find your local event, grab a friend, and join us Saturday as we make these final days count![**VIEW ALL EVENT FLYERS, LOCATIONS & DETAILS HERE.**](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fhiykhl-hhlljjcji-j/)

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: Respectfully asking.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ALEXANDRIA OCASIO-CORTEZ FOR CONGRESS
body:
[1]Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress[2]Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress

[ https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/39214?c0=.hCnSh5&refcode=&t=1001&akid=12497%2E2526796%2Eibkhac ]'New York Times: Ocasio-Cortez Transfers $1 Million to Help El-Sayed in
Final Sprint in Michigan Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez of New
York, who is campaigning in Michigan this week for Dr. Abdul El-Sayed,
transferred $1 million on Friday to a political account to help elect the
fellow progressive to the Senate. The transfer represents a huge sum for a
House member to give to a Senate race, especially one in a different
state. But Ms. Ocasio-Cortez, who is considering a run for president in
2028, has made clear that she believes Dr. El-Sayed’s election would give
a huge boost not just to Democrats this year but also to the broader
progressive movement. “I’m not waking up on November 4th wishing I did
more to combat the smears aimed at Abdul,” Ms. Ocasio-Cortez said in a
statement to The New York Times on Friday. “I’m leaving everything I can
on the field.” Ms. Ocasio-Cortez spent Thursday on a bus trip across
Michigan’s Upper Peninsula with Dr. El-Sayed and is set to hold three
events without him in the Detroit region on Friday. She made the donation
to the Abdul for Michigan Victory Fund, a joint effort between his
campaign, the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee and the Michigan
Democratic State Central Committee. Ms. Ocasio-Cortez is openly weighing
her next political steps, which could include a presidential run, a
re-election campaign or a Senate bid in New York for the seat currently
held by Senator Chuck Schumer, the Democratic leader. Mr. Schumer had
supported Dr. El-Sayed’s rival in the primary but an allied super PAC has
spent more than $30 million so far on Dr. El-Sayed’s bid in the general
election. Whoever wins the Michigan Senate race — Dr. El-Sayed is running
neck and neck against Mike Rogers, a Republican former congressman — could
determine control of the chamber. The relationship between the two
progressive firebrands goes back to 2018, when Ms. Ocasio-Cortez first
ousted a Democratic incumbent in a primary, endorsed Dr. El-Sayed’s
campaign for governor and traveled to Michigan to campaign with him. He
lost that race. She endorsed Dr. El-Sayed, a former public health
official, during the heated Democratic primary for Senate this year. Ms.
Ocasio-Cortez has said that the Michigan Senate race represents an
important proving ground for progressives. “If Abdul can win in Michigan,
anybody can win anywhere,” she said at a recent fund-raiser for him in New
York City. Michigan has been set as one of the early states in 2028
Democratic presidential primary. Ms. Ocasio-Cortez is hardly alone in
showering cash and support on candidates as she considers a run. Gov.
Gavin Newsom of California has used his vast email list to raise money for
Democratic candidates and state parties across the country. And Gov. JB
Pritzker of Illinois, who is a billionaire, has given $1 million to
support the Democratic nominee for governor in Texas, and has also funded
other races. Ms. Ocasio-Cortez reported on Thursday in federal filings
that she had raised $4.7 million in the third quarter this year. She
entered October with nearly $17.4 million in the bank.

Good morning. It's Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez -- asking for
the last time this election if you can make a contribution
of $35 or whatever you can afford to my
campaign.

A small part of every donation we've received this cycle has
gone toward paying for the Fight Oligarchy Tour with Bernie
Sanders, travel and rallies for our endorsed candidates,
organizers we hired in Tennessee and Florida, the $1 million
donation we made to help elect Abdul El-Sayed and Michigan
Democrats and more.

But no matter what happens on Tuesday, we need to be ready
for the day after: Ready to fulfill the promises Democrats [3]Alexandria
made to the American people in this election; Ready for the Ocasio-Cortez
attacks sure to come our way; Ready for whatever campaigns
or challenges come next...

I don’t take corporate money. I don’t dial for dollars.
Never have. So every dollar we put into this fight comes
from people like YOU who decided it was worth it. So for the
last time, I am asking:

[ https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-26-q4.h3BeQC&refcode=em20261029-12497-P_FND_EXP_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=12497%2E2526796%2Eibkhac ]Can you please make a contribution to my campaign today?
Our average donation is around $16. Some give more. Some
give less. The amount of the donation isn't nearly as
important as the number of people chipping in to support our
work. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez

[ https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-26-q4.h3BeQC&refcode=em20261029-12497-P_FND_EXP_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=12497%2E2526796%2Eibkhac ]CONTRIBUTE

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end. Small donors like you keep us going. To contribute via check, please address to Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, PO Box 680080, Corona, NY 11368.

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.ocasiocortez.com/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe-old/?akid=12497%2E2526796%2Eibkhac

body:
Instead of backing down, RGV voters are stepping up.
#
Wow, Peter.
**This weekend in the Rio Grande Valley, Latinos showed the whole country _exactly_ where they stand.**
**[](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20261029-1.215KLR&amount=3&refcode=em20261029-732&t=1&akid=732%2E1366028%2Efl04DM)
[](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20261029-1.215KLR&amount=3&refcode=em20261029-732&t=2&akid=732%2E1366028%2Efl04DM)**
[****](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20261029-1.215KLR&amount=3&refcode=em20261029-732&t=3&akid=732%2E1366028%2Efl04DM)
**More than 8,000 people packed our “Ready. Go. Vote.” rally in Weslaco, Texas. A city of about 40,000. That’s a crowd equal to a quarter of the town’s entire population, all turning out on a Sunday to say they’re ready for change.**
Legendary norteño band **Los Tigres del Norte** headlined the largest rally in Texas this cycle, and the crowd heard from the candidates on this year’s ballot: Texas Senate candidate **James Talarico** , gubernatorial candidate and RGV native **Gina Hinojosa** , and **Bobby Pulido** , who’s running to flip Texas’ 15th Congressional District.
Voters in the Rio Grande Valley have been through a lot. They’re some of the hardest-working people in this country, yet they earn less than the national average. And since Trump took office, this border community has been terrorized by ICE raids and fear. **But instead of backing down, these voters are stepping up, and they’re ready to elect leaders who will stand up for them.**
Sunday’s rally proved that Latino voters are ready, and now our job is to make sure every one of them gets to the polls.
**[Will you make a donation of $3 right now to power Voto Latino’s final push to get out the vote in Texas?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20261029-1.215KLR&amount=3&refcode=em20261029-732&t=4&akid=732%2E1366028%2Efl04DM)**

Thank you,
Voto Latino

That’s a crowd equal to a quarter of the town’s entire population, all turning out on a Sunday to say they’re ready for change. Legendary norteño band Los Tigres del Norte headlined the largest rally in Texas this cycle, and the crowd heard from the candidates on this year’s ballot: Texas Senate candidate James Talarico , gubernatorial candidate and RGV native Gina Hinojosa , and Bobby Pulido , who’s running to flip Texas’ 15th Congressional District. Voters in the Rio Grande Valley have been through a lot. They’re some of the hardest-working people in this country, yet they earn less than the national average. And since Trump took office, this border community has been terrorized by ICE raids and fear. But instead of backing down, these voters are stepping up, and they’re ready to elect leaders who will stand up for them. Sunday’s rally proved that Latino voters are ready, and now our job is to make sure every one of them gets to the polls. Thank you, Voto Latino

body:
#
Peter: _The New York Times_ recently released a profile about VoteVets and the work we’re doing this cycle. Inside, there are some numbers we wanted to make sure you see.
$9.7 million.
That’s the amount we put into Iowa behind Josh Turek’s US Senate primary campaign.
$4.5 million.
That’s the amount we’re putting into Iowa to make sure Josh Turek defeats Ashley Hinson in the general election.
Six.
That’s the amount of times Ashley Hinson voted against War Powers Resolutions that could have stopped the Iran War, before she called for an immediate end to it last month.
$60 million.
That’s how much we’re spending nationwide on elections this cycle.
331.
That’s the number of Democratic candidates we are backing in those elections.
20.
That’s the number of US House and Senate races, and...
311.
That’s the number of down-ballot races we’re supporting. And Peter, that’s the number we want you to think about.
The federal races are the ones that get the most attention. Everyone is invested in what races could flip the House and Senate next week, and we imagine you’re no different. VoteVets candidates will be the difference between a Democratic and Republican Congress in 2027.
But it is those 311 down-ballot races that are the real story. Those are 311 leaders of principle from military families, national security backgrounds, or the armed forces of the United States. Democrats at all levels of government.
Those 311 candidates are the future. And it is support from you that makes that future possible. So, here’s one more number:
**$5.**

**Derek, the DNC can’t launch any more ads before Election Day.**
I’m Lizzie, Digital Ads Director at the DNC. As of Tuesday, my team and I are _barred_ from launching new ads on Facebook or Instagram in the precious 5 days before Election Day. It’s a big deal!
[**I’ll explain why this is so consequential, but first, let me ask: This blackout will make it _even harder_ for the DNC to hit our final fundraising goal before the midterms. Can you chip in $7 to this email to help us catch up?**](https://ak.democrats.org/go/2234?c0=em-dnc-october-2026-gfr.AWsDfI&refcode=em_20261029_10144_fr&amount=7&t=7&akid=10150%2E22930333%2EppjEEH)

So here’s the deal: Meta prohibits political candidates and committees from launching ads in the final week before Election Day. That rule _severely limits_ the DNC’s ability to reach the voters who will cast deciding ballots in just a few days. It also kneecaps our ability to respond to breaking news and get the word out if Trump is scheming to interfere with free and fair elections this year.
**_But that’s not all.**_ It also puts a ceiling on our ability to raise the cash we need to support our army of volunteers in key battlegrounds. These are some of the folks who will win this whole thing for Democrats everywhere, and they’re counting on us.
Look, Republicans have close to **_a BILLION dollars**_ and a cabal of robber barons ready to cut them more checks in the eleventh hour. Meanwhile, we rely on supporters like _you_ to fund our work 5, 50, or even 100 bucks at a time.
**Candidly, Derek, donations to Facebook and Instagram ads make up 24% of the DNC’s digital fundraising (with an average gift of $32!).** And with our hands tied on those platforms, we need to shift gears and overperform on email. Trust me, we really hate to ask more of you, but we could use some help from our top supporters right now.
**We’re not going to let MAGA wannabe kingmakers have the last word in these elections. I hope you’ll join us to help beat Republicans and their billionaire donors.**
[**I’m turning to you and personally asking you to chip in $7 to the DNC to support Democratic get-out-the-vote efforts and help us take back Congress this year:**](https://ak.democrats.org/go/2234?c0=em-dnc-october-2026-gfr.AWsDfI&refcode=em_20261029_10144_fr&amount=7&t=9&akid=10150%2E22930333%2EppjEEH)

name: Jen Kiggans
subject: Call sign
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kiggans for Congress
body:
People often ask...how did I get that name?

People often ask...how did I get that name?
| [](https://trk.email.repdailyred._)
---
That's a picture of me from when I flew H-46 and H-3 helicopters in the U.S. Navy. If you look to my left, you can see my call sign...**Blossom.**
People often ask...how did I get that name?
Well, my roommate in flight school and I went on a bit of a "girl power" kick one day and bought old bathtub non-skid flower stickers from the store, cut out that flower shape in reflective tape from our squadron, and stuck those reflective flowers on our helmets.
There is very little room for making a Navy flight suit more "feminine," but on cruise we were able to be a little more creative and came to love those girly flowers on our helmets.
Although the helicopter community doesn't use call signs as much as some of the fixed wing squadrons, the "Blossom" stuck and was painted on the side of a CH-46 for part of my first cruise. Made for a great photo and story!
It was my experience in the Navy that helped instill in me the importance of service.
Far too often, our elected officials today forget that their job is to SERVE. They think it is their job to tell everyone what to do and why everyone else is wrong....but that's not service.
As a Navy veteran and nurse practitioner, I got so frustrated and decided to run for Congress because I wanted to actually SERVE my country and my community.
**While for some it is all about power, for me it is all about service.**
Sadly, this has made me some enemies in Washington.
No one is going to buy me off or tell me what to do...I'm going to keep serving the people I represent, not serve some "master" in Washington, D.C.
If you are also tired of leaders who care more about power than service, [I'm asking you to send me some help today.](https://trk.email.repdailyred._)
Because I'm a veteran and not a career politician, I need all the help I can get to support my fight against the Democrats.
---
| [RUSH SUPPORT TO JEN](https://trk.email.repdailyred._-9mslFyvymsjmA)
---
I know this was a longer message than you are probably used to getting, but I want you to know where I'm coming from and why I need your help. Whether it's $100 or just $10, anything you can contribute will help this Navy veteran keep fighting back business as usual in D.C.
It's time we support leaders who truly want to serve our country, and that's what I promise to always do...are you with me, Peter?
With the courage to fight,
---
[](https://trk.email.repdailyred._)
---
-Jen
---

[](https://trk.email.repdailyred.)
---
I would not be where I am today without the help of my incredible and faithful supporters like you. Because of your support, I can keep fighting to make our country stronger.

Together we will get our country back on the right track and secure America's success!

Although the helicopter community doesn't use call signs as much as some of the fixed wing squadrons, the "Blossom" stuck and was painted on the side of a CH-46 for part of my first cruise. Made for a great photo and story! It was my experience in the Navy that helped instill in me the importance of service. Far too often, our elected officials today forget that their job is to SERVE. They think it is their job to tell everyone what to do and why everyone else is wrong....but that's not service. As a Navy veteran and nurse practitioner, I got so frustrated and decided to run for Congress because I wanted to actually SERVE my country and my community. While for some it is all about power, for me it is all about service. Sadly, this has made me some enemies in Washington. No one is going to buy me off or tell me what to do...I'm going to keep serving the people I represent, not serve some "master" in Washington, D.C. If you are also tired of leaders who care more about power than service, Because I'm a veteran and not a career politician, I need all the help I can get to support my fight against the Democrats. | I know this was a longer message than you are probably used to getting, but I want you to know where I'm coming from and why I need your help. Whether it's $100 or just $10, anything you can contribute will help this Navy veteran keep fighting back business as usual in D.C. It's time we support leaders who truly want to serve our country, and that's what I promise to always do...are you with me, Peter? With the courage to fight, -Jen I would not be where I am today without the help of my incredible and faithful supporters like you. Because of your support, I can keep fighting to make our country stronger. Together we will get our country back on the right track and secure America's success! | | Paid for by Kiggans for Congress Use of military images or rank does not imply endorsement by the U.S. Department of War or the Navy P.O. subject: WATCH: "It's pretty clear they did not intend to vote"
body:

A Special Message from our SponsorPlease note that views expressed in this message do not necessarily reflect those of Free Speech Daily and do not constitute an endorsement or recommendation by Free Speech Daily.
WATCH: “It’s pretty clear they did not intend to vote”
We stand by our reporting.

‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌
‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNDQsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA865TYlJ_M9--7JNQX5kZ5fjS_xYXQuSNDTPbF-44VJoRvrgVULTJ1RUwT4nqtFPctFwdUq7kfIscVwwX9wfQ3WdYgNmXTkf8G0gkXfaMQ

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNDQsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA865TYlKt6a4b16YGLQB9F2T2IuWyGFtAPjjcYzNw0sur3Lh3pYhVI4CYZlSFMIhuOkqFflJw3Hf7fJ93G2zCrclu7grQXybmAwJeLwYkg

Dear Patriot,

Minnesota charged both myself and fellow journalist Cam Higby with two felony counts in retaliation for our bombshell investigative report on voter vouching laws that we did back in August.

We stand by our reporting.

I recorded a statement on these charges, and
https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNDQsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA865TYlLpU3xSqxkQ83R5mB17vscD2TuvtXFoI1az57A05DFS_G9un8kFIqp2XoPiJgs8NCfD4u99fc2d2CjDHJHe61MSNqhUfY1G1pdWw
I want you to watch it and stand with me.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNDQsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA865TYlME4TAnW4dVPjuiHdsSYpY8Iq3zQmb14l1pWvDPOk3l0tfE6W2-8GHsTo5NNiagzWdft-5jF3uKy-1GXALK6Ion64CMhpwh67uMQ

The charges are an attempt to criminalize investigative journalism. The charges are an attempt to distract from what our reporting exposed as insecure elections in Minnesota. Now, this has become a landmark 1st Amendment case where
https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNDQsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA865TYlN_syU1dfn_KT2j4qpDGzd4idgAIHDtjk7WLdLKhd4qSpaaHNtGyE_mAVWajC9UAOlWJtxKN6B3pe8MyxsES6X1n7dsnQQeiDzEg
everyone's right to speak truth to power has just been put on the line.

Hennepin County Attorney Mary Moriarty led a press conference regarding these charges.
“Today we are charging two individuals, James O'Keefe and Cameron Higby, with felony counts of unlawful voting and identity theft.”— MORIARTY

She also said that Cam and I could do some local jail time for our investigative reporting.

We received a charging document that lists two felony counts.
COUNT IIdentity TheftKnowingly misrepresented his identity in applying for a voting ballot
COUNT IIUnlawful VotingKnowingly misrepresented his identity in applying for a voting ballot

Two counts with the exact same justification beneath each count.

In our report, we clearly stopped and walked out of the polling places to avoid even touching a voting ballot.

Moriarty even said it herself. She admitted that my and Higby's intent was to act as investigative reporters.
“A group of people were attempting to cast doubt on the state's vouching system. I think it's pretty clear they did not intend to vote.”— MORIARTY

They admit we didn't vote. They charged us anyway.
https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNDQsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA865TYlOhIc7o_l-3y_lI82YncfExVDCDATUxBtBWbIdqZEQkGPGaxq2a42yrGuadZn29y7L2zbwQ2E760ZeA8mBpV8XHZR_toU9qSfEPw
Watch my statement and stand with me.

Moriarty also said there is no such thing as undercover journalism when looking into election loopholes.
“If you identify as a journalist, there is no such thing as undercover investigation in the polling place. You have to identify yourself as a journalist in the polling place, which they did not.”— MORIARTY

Moriarty is wrong as a matter of constitutional law.

The 1st Amendment allows reporters to show up on Election Day and ask questions at polling booths.

But don't take my word for it. In 2012, former Attorney General of the United States Eric Holder went under oath in Washington, D.C. discussing an almost identical investigation asking if the polling official has Eric Holder's ballot at a precinct on primary day there.
“What I drew from that video was that [O'Keefe] was very careful not to say that he was Eric Holder, not to actually get a ballot. He didn't do the kinds of things that would have subjected him to criminal prosecution.”— ERIC HOLDER

In today's press conference, Moriarty points out this distinction, too.
“So, there's a difference between intent to vote and intent to apply for a ballot. The application of a ballot is a multi-step process. I can't anticipate what [O'Keefe and Higby's] defense is. I'm sure we'll hear from them.”— MORIARTY

Our defense is the shield of the 1st Amendment to hold government accountable to the people.

We didn't apply for a ballot; we were there talking to election clerks, posing hypotheticals, and getting answers so that Americans could know what was happening in the elections.

Many people in the United States did not even know about vouching for eight, and this investigative report educated them.

By the way, we conducted training and specifically told each journalist never to sign an affidavit, never to procure a ballot, never to even touch a ballot.

We even did exercises training the journalists to say “the name is” rather than “my name is.” We were very intentional about what we were there to do, namely was to inform the public.

Moriarty admitted that we stopped short of signing any oath or carrying out any fraud.
“Both men stopped short of signing the oath we all sign before receiving our ballot.”— MORIARTY

The reporters in the room questioned Moriarty on what exactly we're being prosecuted for.
“Does that give them a way to say that we didn't commit a crime because we didn't take it all the way? … Can you explain why you think it's still a crime?”— A REPORTER AT THE PRESS CONFERENCE

So again, what exactly are we being prosecuted for? What is this really about?

Make no mistake, this is about prosecuting the press, and this isn't the first time something like this has happened to me.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNDQsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA865TYlPwyO-yUsU2L9G7EC4LiKRHZKALPxz0O5GIADeDLdFupG2zJBM_b8cvIpBYgsNGkrj4biK2bY8YDHyx9qwr3hK_-3q1ei3GCrthQ
STAND WITH JAMES →

In New Orleans, LA, they falsely accused me of a felony and later admitted there was no felony. The U.S. attorneys involved in that case were eventually disbarred.

The federal prosecutor was so furious about this case that he literally threw my book at me.
“You're a nasty, little, cowardly spud. You are scum! I recused from your case!”— PROSECUTOR JIM LETTEN

Then there was the case when the FBI came knocking at my house. Agents stormed into my home and unlocked my phone to get access to my Signal in order to intimidate me and to intimidate the sources that come to me.

It was such a landmark First Amendment case that the American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU) filed amicus, and the Reporters Committee for Freedom of the Press came to my defense.

I have been to the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals, challenging the constitutionality of Oregon's recording laws. Got a reversal there.

I went up to the 1st Circuit Court of Appeals in Massachusetts there. We won a partial victory.

In another civil case, Shirley Teter v. O'Keefe, I won at directed verdict. For that case, there were six pro-bono lawyers representing the plaintiff, who stated, “We're not paid by the Hillary Clinton campaign or by the Democratic Party or anything like that.” The federal judge pointed out the unsolicited statement only raised further questions, and ordered them to pay my legal fees.

I have been sued so many times and have had so many criminal threats made against me that even the media that hates me is forced to acknowledge that I have established legal 1st Amendment precedent throughout the nation.

We also overturned a jury verdict against me in the D.C. Circuit Court of Appeals last month before a panel of judges, which were appointed by Democrats. We convinced the panel to side with the 1st Amendment, creating a new standard for undercover journalism across the board.

It's now called the “O'Keefe Principle.” On publication injury when undercover journalism is involved.

I've won these fights before.
https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNDQsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA865TYlQoot3nWP4rjDHHQoW7Jv7saKOdj3o0KoZaripFePJBayRsnS0A_5zTWfAD9mZTL0UB3NspPbtbEgDjXr0uUaHvcNGXQub2eVgUA
Stand with me and help me win this one.

The politics of fear and weaponized lawfare don't seem to work against me. It never has. Actually, it has always backfired against the people who come after me.

Why is that? It's because what's at issue here is not actually political; it's fundamental.

This is about whether citizens still have a right to ask questions of their government servants, and such a fundamental right will always prevail if you do not cower at their threats.

And the thing about me is — I never settle.

Most people find lawsuits stressful. The process becomes a form of punishment, but not to me. I actually love this process.

I enjoy this process.

I'm going to have fun with this process.

Because it allows me to expose injustice at the highest levels.

There is nothing as sweet as justice, and there is nothing as motivating as injustice.

And in this case, they have put your right to speak on the line.
https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNDQsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA865TYlR6VQg504OH70mYD1itZ0g6WjcLZvDVogYbeAJlYX7vV2AHwKydmOXWS0PLuw3yE_SzUpJkAuCJTifjfCW0UsxR5KIsp5jtoe7Tw
Everything we believe in as Americans has been put on the line.

But it does seem to indicate the direction of where our country is going.

I recognize that we're well past the point of being completely divided in this country, but this case isn't about what divides us; it's about what unites us. What unites us is so much stronger than what divides us. Because the right to question authority and educate people matters to people on all sides.

Ironically, Moriarty put out a statement on social media and restricted the comments section on her official X government account, which violates the 1st Amendment.

And now, I'm summoned to appear before the Hennepin County judge on Monday, Nov. 16th, just four days after our Citizen Journalism Gala, where we'll host many people who don't all agree with each other on public policy. And yet, each of them all stands united behind the 1st Amendment.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNDQsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA865TYlSYwZ_7qaWPd3XNnl5Yyy7wsuu6FBmHNYJZyDovnyH6e7yWKUeBDJ0e9xW5fxBCE-xfBc-siJX8RPN0v2HOMp1nngi9HUGIgA0vw
SUMMONED TO APPEARMONDAY, NOV. 16Hennepin County, MinnesotaTWO FELONY COUNTS - I NEVER SETTLE

That's why I'm calling on all Americans, and not just independent journalists, but especially those in the mainstream or legacy media institutions,
https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNDQsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA865TYlTeRTy1z5RmLgno7PTubC__u9gxdbn-hJrOJIrgwTHX-wchbVBFYngReUZ3TA4qG3_INqfMuoWLIS8UoYmN420IKhNUj9SQ_lwow

body:
Let’s finish the job together.
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=2218%2E1086043%2Eh4KiiG)
I want to tell you something I don’t say enough, Peter.
_Four years ago, when I first ran for office, we polled lower than "Not Voting."**Seriously.** 🙃 _
I had never run for political office. Few people had heard of me. The Democratic Party had handpicked other candidates. Nobody gave us a chance.
But I did not let fear lead. My journey has always been an improbable one.
I grew up as the son of an immigrant single mother. I didn’t come from money or prestige. I came from hard work, community, and an unshakable belief that Maryland could be better.
That’s how we went from polling at 1% to winning by double digits. We had a lot of grit, we worked alongside the grassroots, and we fought to leave no one behind. We traveled from Oakland to Ocean City. We listened. And we won.
Now we have to do it again, and the clock is running out.
**In 5 days, Marylanders will decide whether we keep moving forward or hand this state to Dan Cox and the MAGA donors bankrolling his campaign. Every ad we run, every door we knock, and every voter we reach between now and then could make the difference.[Can you chip in $5 today to help us cross the finish line?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20261029-1.RjR_s-&refcode=em-20261029-1&t=2&akid=2218%2E1086043%2Eh4KiiG)**

subject: Quite a journey
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
Growing up, this kid learned that through hard work, he could do anything he set his mind to.
#

Growing up, this kid learned that through hard work, he could do anything he set his mind to.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct26.SGbrxo&refcode=em261029-1-MS&t=1&akid=6798%2E6688874%2EXWvGP6)
At the age of 23, he became a United States naval aviator. He deployed twice on the U.S.S. Midway and flew 39 combat missions in Operation Desert Storm.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct26.SGbrxo&refcode=em261029-1-MS&t=2&akid=6798%2E6688874%2EXWvGP6)
Then, at the age of 32, he was selected as an astronaut (with his twin brother, Scott!). He flew his first of four missions into space in 2001 aboard Space Shuttle Endeavour. He spent more than 50 days in space and has lived on the International Space Station.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct26.SGbrxo&refcode=em261029-1-MS&t=3&akid=6798%2E6688874%2EXWvGP6)
In 2011, Mark's wife, Former Congresswoman Gabby Giffords, was shot in Tucson during an event where she was meeting with her constituents. Mark retired from the Navy and NASA, and his mission turned from service to his country to caring for his wife. But Gabby's service in Congress, using policy to improve people's lives, stuck with him.
So, in 2020, Mark took on his next mission — running for U.S. Senate in Arizona — and won.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct26.SGbrxo&refcode=em261029-1-MS&t=4&akid=6798%2E6688874%2EXWvGP6)
Then, in 2022, he had to turn around and run for a full term in the Senate. And thanks to our incredible team, he won again.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct26.SGbrxo&refcode=em261029-1-MS&t=5&akid=6798%2E6688874%2EXWvGP6)
Now, Mark’s in yet another important position. As Vice Chair of the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee, it’s been on Mark to find a way to defend every incumbent Democrat in the Senate. And, to win back our majority, he’s got to take four seats back from the GOP, too.
That’d be more than enough for most people, but things got even more complicated last year. First it was guys like Elon Musk calling Mark a traitor. Then Roger Stone called for Mark’s execution. And in November, the full weight of the Executive Branch started coming for Mark, personally.
It’s a lot. And with all of that on Mark’s shoulders, we know it’d mean a lot to him if he had your support. So, we’re humbly asking you:
[**Can you make a $5 contribution as we approach this critical end-of-month deadline? Mark can’t do this alone.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct26.SGbrxo&refcode=em261029-1-MS&t=6&akid=6798%2E6688874%2EXWvGP6)
_If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly:_
| | **[DONATE $5](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1395?c0=mek-em-oct26.gs1FCm&amount=5&refcode=em261029-1-MS&t=7&akid=6798%2E6688874%2EXWvGP6)**
---
****
| **[DONATE MORE](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1395?c0=mek-em-oct26.gs1FCm&refcode=em261029-1-MS&t=8&akid=6798%2E6688874%2EXWvGP6)**
---
****
Thanks for being on Mark’s team.
Team Kelly

subject: Don’t let this one get away from us.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
I’ve watched too many Senate races slip away in the final 5 days. Not this one.
Hi. It's James Carville, and I’ll be straight with you: **I’m sweating this race like a glass of iced tea on a July porch.**
The election is 5 days away. FIVE. I’ve been in this business long enough to know that the last 5 days are when Senate races are won or when they slip away while good people are still meaning to get around to helping.
**[If you’ve been waiting to chip in to Chris Pappas, I’m asking you to do it right now. Not next week. Right now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261029_1.ckN5mW&refcode=em20261029-1&t=1&akid=9837%2E582294%2ED2aDeZ)**
**[Donate »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261029_1.ckN5mW&amount=25&refcode=em20261029-1&t=2&akid=9837%2E582294%2ED2aDeZ)**
Here’s what we’re up against. Republicans are spending **$66 million** to take this seat. Those Sununus have been running New Hampshire politics like a family business for more than forty years. John Sununu’s daddy was governor. His brother was governor. Now John wants his old Senate seat back, even though Granite Staters showed him the door in 2008.
National Republicans know exactly what this race means. New Hampshire is a Democratic-held seat. If they flip it, there’s no path to a Democratic Senate majority. If Democrats hold it, we may just flip the Senate.
Chris Pappas has won the toughest district in New Hampshire **_four damn times_**. He knows how to close. But closing costs money: ads in the final stretch, mail hitting doors, organizers knocking from Nashua to the North Country. Every dollar that comes in this week will be spent before Election Day. # One Last Thought Until Next Week
---
| | |
---
Hey everybody,
To quote the late Robert Hunter of The Grateful Dead, "What a long strange trip it's been."
We started driving through these eleven counties in the second half of June 2025. Fifteen months and 35,000 miles later, we're down to the end, and in the last few weeks have felt like we have been closing the circle.
The first county Democratic party we visited was with the Randolph County Blues. We visited them for the third time two weeks ago. This time, instead of me asking a lot of questions to learn what the county needed or giving a speech about how we were going to help the county, we got to sit and chat with people who have become friends.
Our first big public event was in October 2025 at Fall on Main in Roanoke. We went back this weekend, and the vibe had shifted. Last year, the election was more than a year away, and overseas farm markets collapsed because of tariffs, so people had more pressing concerns. This year, only one person refused to talk to me, and he was very polite. Hundreds of people stopped to talk about the election and to hear what we're saying about the issues. Lots of people said they had seen me online, and they were voting for me, and more than a few stopped by to say they had already voted absentee for me.
Then on Thursday, we're heading back to Heflin for a Cleburne County Democratic Party meeting. I went to the Cleburne County party in the summer of 2025. We've been there a few times in the last 15 months, and it will be our last county meeting before the election.
The one stop I wanted to make but couldn't was in Tallapoosa County. Tallapoosa has been so supportive of this campaign over the last year, and I really wanted to make their candidates' forum, but I felt I needed to close the circle and go back to Fall on Main. I had nothing to worry about. Barb represented the campaign, and everyone said she knocked it out of the park.
I'll be honest: I'm exhausted, but looking back over the last 15 months, I'm incredibly proud of what we've accomplished. Next week, after the votes are counted, I'll write something to tell you all what this means to me. But right now, it is unbelievable that I get to say...
We are 7 days away from the general election.
Be well. We'll talk soon,

Lee
